description: Prompted object removal and fitted Gaussian background completion
commands: uv run physicalview run inpainting --config configs/local.yaml --scene room --objects 0 --out outputs/scenes/room_factory --prompt "Remove the mug and restore the desk." --iters 1000
inputs: Selected object IDs, masks, original scene and prompt
outputs: Edited views, model receipts and clean background Gaussian PLY. Surface refinement modules are experiments; current removal artifacts are documented.
